authority: Observed in projects/utah-forge/project.json, environment.json, DATA_LAYER_STATUS.md, Layer-Artifact-Classification.md, Computed-Artifact-Pipeline.md, Project-Load-Class-Table.md, and existing seismic manifest/inventory/navigation/provenance files.

inputs.role: GDR 1015 and GDR 1141 processed seismic source products
inputs.notes: Project metadata identifies GDR submissions 1015 and 1141 as seismic source products.
Navigation exists and supports placement; fallback/legacy placement caveats require review.
Inventory exists and should remain available for seismic source review.

producedBy.notes: Script observed read-only; no script was run in this pass. Demo recipes are associated with prep/build_utah_forge_seismic_demo_recipes.mjs.

crs.notes: Navigation and CRS fields are observed in the seismic manifest. Product vertical datum is parsed from SEG-Y text headers when present, with 1800 m ASL as the fallback/reference datum. Survey-grade navigation placement and 58-32 visual calibration still require review.
crs.verticalDatum: product-specific SEG-Y datum; rendered as absolute scene elevation metres for depth products and display-derived vertical scale for time products

units.vertical: absolute scene elevation metres; product sample values are converted with sceneZ_m = datumM - sample * verticalScaleMPerUnit
units.scalar: processed seismic amplitude or interval velocity depending on product
units.notes: Products mix time, depth, velocity-time, and amplitude/velocity display domains. Product-specific datum, sample units, vertical transform, and value encoding are recorded in seismic_manifest.json.

scalar.transform: processed amplitudes and velocity products are stored as uint8 p02-p98 normalized textures; velocity legend display range is 2000-5000 m/s unless source metadata supersedes it
scalar.notes: Environment and recipes include amplitude windows and colormaps, but this wrapper does not accept defaults.

processing.method: Render-transcoded seismic sections and raymarch-capable products from processed seismic products

calibration.source: FORGE report calibration point near well 58-32

processing.downsampling: Raymarch products include reduced volume dimensions; product-specific dimensions and encoding require review.
processing.masking: Background removal/windowing varies by product or recipe and requires review.
processing.notes: Seismic is needed and underway, not parked. Source-header datum parsing and value-encoding metadata are present; default demo behavior and 58-32 visual calibration remain unresolved.

stats.notes: Counts are observed from existing seismic manifest/status evidence. Product-specific amplitude stats and sample domains should be reviewed from the manifest before acceptance.

render.colorRamp: blue-white-red or velocity colormap depending on product/recipe, needs review
render.materialNotes: Raymarch/section selection, opacity, colormap, amplitude window, navigation visibility, labels, and MT co-rendering quality need visual review before client-facing acceptance.
render.notes: This wrapper does not change or accept seismic rendering, default visibility, product filtering, or demo recipe behavior.

provenance.notes: Existing provenance file observed. Older blocked/not-active seismic docs still need supersession review.

limitations: Seismic is needed and underway, not parked.
Does not approve default demo behavior, default visibility, product filtering, or render mode.
Older blocked/not-active seismic docs still need human supersession review.
Engineering-grade interpretation requires qualified professional review; no seismic reflector is accepted here as a fault, target, mineralized structure, or resource estimate.
Product filtering, raymarch/section selection, amplitude windows, colormaps, navigation display, and visual evidence remain incomplete.
58-32 visual calibration is pending because the active demo borehole layer does not include 58-32.
